rule: A visible endpoint component is either readable at the profile floor or absent from that presentation profile.

sources.cause: The left audience figure was nearly fully depth-occluded in dense multi-state Event emblems, leaving 1–2 raster pixels.
sources.fix: Keep its real particles in the fixed-stride endpoint buffer, but omit the optional subfeature from all presentation profiles; stage-deck, portal-arch, and other audience figures preserve the Event emblem.

sources.cause: The right audience figure in a directed four-competency DRIVE endpoint reduced to one visible pixel at mobile390.
sources.fix: A deterministic DRIVE+mobile390 presentation rule omits this optional subfeature. FOCUS/GATHER mobile390 and DRIVE desktop retain it.
